summary: OpenAI and Microsoft announced an amended partnership agreement described as simplifying their relationship and providing long-term clarity for continued AI development.

categories.reason: The amended agreement restructures the core compute and commercial relationship between OpenAI and its hyperscale cloud partner Microsoft.
categories.quote: OpenAI and Microsoft announce an amended agreement that simplifies the partnership, adds long-term clarity, and supports continued AI innovation at scale.

notable_reason: A restructuring of the Microsoft-OpenAI partnership is a major structural event for the sector even though this summary lacks concrete terms.
